magic_shulker_boxes.title: Magic Shulker Boxes settings
magic_shulker_boxes.admin.help: Admin commands: /msb admin show, set, reset, permission, permissions, ledger, player. Use /msb admin show for settings and clickable commands.
magic_shulker_boxes.admin.dormant: The server value remains active until personal changes are permitted for this option.
magic_shulker_boxes.admin.reset_option: %s now uses the server value for %s.
magic_shulker_boxes.admin.reset: Cleared all personal choices for %s, including locked options. All settings now follow the server.
magic_shulker_boxes.admin.load_failed: Could not read player settings. The original file is kept; check the server log.
magic_shulker_boxes.help: View: /msb show. Change: /msb set <option> <value>. Use server values: /msb reset [option]. Toggles use true/false; refillAmount uses 1–64; makeSpaceMode uses DISABLED, MOVE_TO_BOX or DROP_AND_PICKUP.
magic_shulker_boxes.reset: Cleared personal choices for editable options. These settings now follow the server.
magic_shulker_boxes.locked: The server manages this option. Ask an administrator to permit personal changes.
magic_shulker_boxes.pickup_off: Automatic storage is off. Refilling can be enabled separately.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill_off: Schematic refilling is off. Other storage and refill settings apply separately.
magic_shulker_boxes.invalid: Settings unchanged. Check options with /msb show. Toggles use true/false; refillAmount uses 1–64; makeSpaceMode uses DISABLED, MOVE_TO_BOX or DROP_AND_PICKUP.
magic_shulker_boxes.save_failed: Could not save settings. Check the input and server log, then try again.
magic_shulker_boxes.reloaded: Reloaded the server configuration. The new settings are active.
magic_shulker_boxes.reload_failed: Could not reload the configuration. Previous settings remain active; check the server log.
magic_shulker_boxes.client_failed: Could not read or save local preferences. Check config/magic_shulker_boxes-client.json and the client log.
magic_shulker_boxes.option.preferExistin: Use existing boxes before making room
magic_shulker_boxes.option.matchItemComp: Require all item details to match
magic_shulker_boxes.description.splitSta: Before changing stacked boxes, separate one into a free slot. The remaining boxes keep their contents. Supports Carpet box stacking.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.useEmpty: Allow storage to be allocated from an empty shulker box when matching boxes cannot fit the items. When off, relocation, refill/tool replacement, crafting remainders and the stacked-empty-box shortcut no longer create managed boxes; already marked boxes remain usable.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.local_hint: Set defaults for singleplayer and LAN worlds. Saving applies them. Other servers use their own settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.allowPar: Allow partial stacks, such as 3 stone, to move when making room. When off, only stacks at their own maximum size may move.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.pickupSt: Store newly acquired items after pickups, container transfers and villager trades. Off by default. Cursor items are stored only after entering your inventory. Refilling has separate switches.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.matchIte: Item type and key contents always match: potion contents and duration scale, stew effects, enchanted books, maps, fireworks, goat horn sounds and ominous bottle levels. Enable to also require matching names, equipment enchantments, durability and all other details. Stack merging always requires an exact match.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.useHotba: Allow relocation from the hotbar when making room. When off, only main inventory items may move. Individually protected hotbar slots stay protected.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.busy: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.failed: Failed. Check the log and try again.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.makeSpac: If a split box needs a free slot, stop, move a stack into a box, or drop it for pickup. Choose “Move into a box” to avoid dropping items.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.pickup_off: Automatic storage is off by default on this server. Enable it if personal changes are permitted.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.refill_off: Schematic refilling is off by default on this server. Enable it if personal changes are permitted.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.allowPla: Allow players to change the options permitted below. When off, all players use the settings on this page.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.useMatch: Prefer boxes containing only matching items. Fill the fuller matching boxes first.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.status.LOCKED: The server manages personal settings. Singleplayer hosts can open “Current world settings”.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.missing_yacl: Install YACL 3.8.2 for Fabric 1.21.11 to open this screen. You can also use /msb commands or configuration files.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.includeO: Include your offhand shulker box for storage and schematic refilling. IPN keeps its own source rules.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.status.OFFLINE: Preferences are stored locally and used on servers that permit personal settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.recovery_unavail: Update the server mod and reconnect.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.preferEm: When matching boxes cannot fit an item, try empty boxes before ordinary inventory. Turn off to use free inventory space first. Available matching boxes always take priority.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.invalid_file: Could not read the configuration. The original file is kept; check its JSON and the log, then try again.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.preferEx: Try available space in existing boxes before making room to split another box.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.status.ALLOWED: Change permitted options, or choose “Use server value” to follow its defaults.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.unsaved_body: Switching pages discards this draft. Choose “Keep editing” to return and save it.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.refillMa: When the hotbar is full, allow replacing the selected stack and storing it. When off, never replace a non-empty hotbar slot and keep the backpack fallback. Stop if the displaced stack cannot be stored safely; no items are dropped, and hotbar protection and partial-stack settings apply.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.changed: Source items changed; nothing taken. Try again.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.missing: No matching materials found. Check eligible boxes and refill sources.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.space: No usable inventory slot; nothing taken. Check space, relocation and box splitting settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.unsupported: This server does not support refilling. Install a compatible Magic Shulker Boxes version.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.disabled: Schematic refilling is off. Enable it in settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.refillFa: Show failures such as disabled refilling or changed source items. Space failures use “Show space failure reasons”. Successful refills are silent.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.schemati: Refill from shulker boxes when Litematica Easy Place lacks materials, preferring less filled boxes. Uses “Items per refill”. Both client and server need this mod.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.craftRef: Use carried box contents when placing a recipe. After taking the output, restore the input pattern if all missing ingredients are available. Vanilla recipes and remainders apply; the recipe determines quantities. The server performs refills; a compatible client also shows box-backed recipes as craftable.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.ipnRefil: Offer backpack box contents when IPN cannot find an ordinary inventory replacement. Uses “Items per refill”. IPN controls triggers, matching, tool durability and sorting. Locked slots and relocation protection apply. Both sides need this mod; the client also needs IPN.
magic_shulker_boxes.option.enderChestRef: Allow refilling from your ender chest
magic_shulker_boxes.description.enderChe: Let schematic, crafting and IPN refills use your own ender chest items and boxes without opening it. Carried sources take priority.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.permissions_hint: Enable “Permit personal settings”, then choose which options players may change. Other options use this page’s values.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.permission_hint: Allow players to choose their own value for %s.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.partial_permissi: Greyed-out options are managed by the server. Other permitted options can be changed.
magic_shulker_boxes.command.preview:
Click to fill the command, then press Enter to apply:
%s
magic_shulker_boxes.command.hint: Click a value to fill its command; press Enter to change settings. Quantities accept any whole number from 1 to 64.

magic_shulker_boxes.server.field_allowed: Personal changes permitted when the master switch is on
magic_shulker_boxes.storage.no_space: Not enough space. Free an inventory slot or provide a matching or empty box for the displaced items.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.spaceFai: Show a notice above the hotbar when displaced items cannot fit a matching or separate empty box. All entry points share a two-second notice interval. Turning this off only hides the notice.
magic_shulker_boxes.junk.managed: Automatic junk box · marker clears outside your inventory
magic_shulker_boxes.ledger.title: Schematic refill provenance
magic_shulker_boxes.ledger.empty: No provenance entries. Entries clear when the items leave your inventory.
magic_shulker_boxes.ledger.offline: The player is offline; provenance is kept in online memory only.
magic_shulker_boxes.ledger.player_only: Run this as a player, or use /msb admin ledger <player>.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.protectH: When making room, never relocate slot 1 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 2 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 3 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 4 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 5 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 6 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 7 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 8 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
When making room, never relocate slot 9 or place an automatically split box there. This slot stays protected even if other hotbar slots may move.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.refillAm: Take 1–64 items from one source slot per schematic or IPN refill, limited by available items and their stack limit. Unstackable items yield 1; items capped at 16 yield at most 16. Crafting follows the recipe; tool swaps take 1. The personal slider’s leftmost choice uses the server value.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.invalid: Invalid value. Check settings and save.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.locked: This option is managed by the server.
